verses.1: Having these things, therefore, with us, beloved ones, let us be purified from all contamination of body and spirit, so that we may achieve holiness in the fear of God.
verses.2: You have separated us from each other. We didn’t receive anything, we weren’t taken away from anywhere, and we weren’t exploited in any way.
verses.3: I do not say this for judgment’s sake; I have requested that we be together in order to die together.
verses.4: I have much to offer you; I have great joy in serving you. I will fulfill this promise, and I will bring joy to all our sorrows.
verses.5: And when we went to Makedonia, our lives were filled with nothing but suffering. We were in pain everywhere—from outside, from battles; from inside, from fear.
verses.6: But the Lord called upon us, those who were humble, during the appearance of Titus.
verses.7: Not only in his presence, but also in the message he brought to you, he revealed your sufferings, your hardships, and your struggles on my behalf. This made me even happier.
verses.8: Even though I have offended you in that letter, I do not regret it. Even if I did regret it (I see that that letter indeed offended you),
verses.9: I now rejoice, not because you were sad, but because you were sad in order to reflect on yourself. You were sad according to God’s will, so that you wouldn’t suffer any harm from us.
verses.10: For the sorrow that comes from God is a means of salvation; whereas the sorrow of this world leads to death.
verses.11: For this act of harming God caused you great sorrow, not only pride, but also regret, hatred, fear, desperation, and revenge. In every situation, you refused to accept that you were guilty of such a deed.
verses.12: Therefore, even though I have written to you, it is not because of those who are unjust, nor because of those who have been wronged. It is because we want to show your love for us before God’s eyes.
verses.13: For this reason, we should ask for forgiveness. But upon our request, we were even more grateful to Titus, because his spirit is now free from all of your troubles.
verses.14: For if I am offended by something on your behalf, I will not be upset. Instead, just as we have always told you the truth, so too did our offense against Titus become a matter of truth.
verses.15: And his wounds are a reminder for you of your enduring strength in the face of all hardships. It shows that, despite fear and terror, you still can endure.
verses.16: I am glad that I can always rely on you.
